chapters.title: Okay fine, the fix (Bom made me)

text.first-impression: Im, people meet you and feel like they've walked into a fun, slightly elusive story. You're curious, clever, adventurous, with three fascinating anecdotes and a trip coming up. Ten seconds in, they want to know you. Ten weeks in, they're still trying to pin you down. What they don't see: your mind is always somewhere else, half planning the next thing, the next city, the next idea. You're present, mostly. About eighty percent. The other twenty is already boarding a different flight. It's charming. It's also very obvious to everyone sitting with you.
text.your-red-flag: Your red flag: you disappear. Not dramatically. You just drift, stop replying, go and do your own thing for a week, then come back like nothing happened. To you, it's freedom. To everyone else, it's a slightly anxious are we okay? You also avoid commitment like it's a parking ticket. And you can turn cool when things get emotional, retreating into logic. Let's think about this rationally is not a hug. Nobody in tears has ever wanted a flowchart. A two-line heads-up before you vanish would solve about ninety percent of this.
text.how-you-sabotage-love: In love you bring excitement, spontaneity, and huge conversations at 3am. Partners feel like life got bigger. Then they try to make plans for next month and you get strange about it. Your sabotage is leaving emotionally the moment something feels like a cage, even if the cage is just my parents would like to meet you. Commitment isn't a prison. It's a home port. You can sail as far as you like and still come back to the same harbour. That's the whole point of a harbour. Try staying for one dinner.
text.friends-and-work: At work you're the visionary: big ideas, strong strategy, terrible with forms. You get bored with routine and sometimes leave the boring part for someone else to finish. With friends you're the adventure friend, the one with a plan for the spontaneous weekend. But you're hard to reach. Your replies are basically seasonal. Your friends miss you, and they're too polite to say how much. Answer the group chat. They've started a poll on whether you still exist. One reply a week would change everything. They're not asking for a novel, just a sign of life.
text.the-lie: The lie you tell yourself: I just value my freedom. Sometimes it's freedom. Sometimes it's avoidance wearing a very nice coat. You also tell yourself you don't really get attached. You do. You just leave before anyone sees it, including you. That isn't independence. That's running, in good shoes, with a great playlist. Admitting that you care doesn't anchor you forever. It just means someone finally gets to know where you are. Try saying I missed you to someone, before you leave again. It won't trap you. It'll just feel unfamiliar, then good, in that order.
text.the-fix: The fix, because Bom demanded it. Reply within a day, even if it's just busy, love you, talk soon. Finish one boring task each week, fully, to the very end. Stay in one emotional conversation until it's actually over, no logic exit halfway through. In love, try one small commitment and notice that nothing terrible happens. You're the ocean: deep and free. Everyone wants some of that. Let someone stand on the shore and wave you home. You might even like the wave. Start with the group chat. Today. Right now, actually.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Im. You replied to my message from March. It's not March.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Free-spirited. Also emotionally on another continent.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: 'Let's think about this rationally' is not a hug, Im.

panels.speaker: bom
panels.text: Life is so exciting with Im around.

panels.speaker: yeon
panels.text: Agreed. Now answer the group chat. They think you vanished.

spring.intro: Spring Im, Wood ran your birth season and Water feeds Wood, so you're a river in flood: full of ideas, plans and enthusiasm for other people's dreams. People see someone exciting and inspiring. Your friends know you've started four hobbies this year and finished none. Your red flag is overflowing and moving on. You pour energy into a new thing, a new friend, a new crush, then flow somewhere else before it roots. In love you're thrilling and hard to count on. At work your brainstorms are legendary and your follow-through is mythical. The fix: one project, one month, done. Then you're allowed the next shiny thing.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pottery, bouldering, Italian, sourdough. Four hobbies this year. Zero finished. Im, babe.

summer.intro: Summer Im, Fire ran your season and Water controls Fire, so you're constantly managing heat: deadlines, drama, other people's chaos. You're good at it. People see someone breezy and fun. Your friends know you dodge every serious conversation with a perfectly timed joke and a change of subject. Your red flag is emotional evasion. You keep things light because heavy feels like being trapped. In love partners never quite reach the deep end with you. At work you defuse conflicts brilliantly and never resolve them. The fix: when a serious conversation starts, stay in it for ten minutes without escaping. Set a timer if you must.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Changing the subject to your holiday plans mid-argument is not resolving anything, Im.

autumn.intro: Autumn Im, Metal ran your birth season and Metal generates Water, so you're a strong, deep current that knows exactly how capable it is. Confident, adventurous, a little grand. People see someone who's done everything and been everywhere. Your friends know you'll vanish for two weeks and reappear with a tan and no explanation. Your red flag is independence that edges into unavailability. You don't need anyone, and you make sure they know it. In love partners feel like an optional stop on your route. At work you do things your own way, always. The fix: tell people your plans before you disappear. Mystery wears thin. Consistency doesn't.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Ghosting the group chat for two weeks, then posting from a beach. Classic Im.

winter.intro: Winter Im, Water ran your season and doubled your element, so you're the deep ocean: calm surface, enormous depths, absolutely no visibility. People see someone cool and unbothered. Your friends know there's a whole storm system down there and you'll never mention it. Your red flag is emotional opacity. You feel everything and share nothing, then feel lonely that nobody understands you. In love partners keep diving and never find the bottom. At work you're steady and impossible to read in meetings. The fix: say one true thing about how you feel each week, out loud, to someone you trust. Surface occasionally. People like seeing you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Im has so much going on inside. Let us see a little of it!

strength.strong: Strong chart, Im. Your waters run deep and wide, which makes you charismatic, adventurous and slightly allergic to commitment of any kind. Plans, people, even a gym membership. The blind spot: you treat everything as optional, including other people's feelings. You change plans last minute because something better came up and assume everyone's fine with it. In love partners feel like a port of call. At work you have vision and no patience for details. The fix: keep one commitment you're tempted to drop. Be boringly reliable once.
strength.weak: Weak chart, Im, so your water doesn't have strong banks and it spills into whatever's nearest. The blind spot: you're scattered and call it spontaneous. You start things, drop things, follow whoever's loudest. In love you take on your partner's plans and lose your own. At work you say yes to everything and finish half. The fix: pick one personal goal and protect it from other people's plans for a month. A river with banks is still a river. It just gets places.

balance_text.too_much_wood: Too much Wood. You're all growth, plans and ambition, and you never stop reaching. Cute. Also exhausting. You start projects faster than you finish them, and you think rest is for people with fewer goals. You argue to win rather than to understand. Yeon's prescription: prune. Finish one thing before starting another. Say you're right once a week and mean it. A tree that never stops growing eventually just falls over.
balance_text.missing_wood: Missing Wood. Starting things is hard for you, so you just... don't. You wait for the right moment, and the right moment is apparently very busy. You have plans in drafts and ideas in your notes app from three years ago. Yeon's prescription: take the first ugly step today. Send the email. Sign up for the class. Buy the plant. Momentum isn't a mood. It's a decision you make before you feel ready.
balance_text.too_much_fire: Too much Fire. Everything's urgent, everything's dramatic, and your feelings arrive with sirens on. You're fun and bright, and you're also impulsive, and you've sent messages you'd love to unsend. Yeon's prescription: wait one night before any big decision. Drink water, literally and spiritually. Let your calmest friend talk you down before your wildest one hypes you up. Your spark is great. Your house fires are not.
balance_text.missing_fire: Missing Fire. You're lovely, but you're keeping your light on its dimmest setting. You hang back, never celebrate yourself, and assume people won't notice you anyway. That isn't modesty. It's hiding with good manners. Yeon's prescription: be seen. Post the thing, wear the colour, tell the joke out loud. Go outside in the sun. People can't love what they can't see, and you're worth seeing.
balance_text.too_much_earth: Too much Earth. You're stable. Very stable. Possibly too stable. Same restaurant, same route, same opinion, same worry on repeat. You call it reliable. It's also a rut with nice furniture. Yeon's prescription: one new thing a week. It doesn't have to be big. A new food, a new walk, a new person to talk to. Growth needs a little mess, and you can tidy it up afterwards if it makes you feel better.
balance_text.missing_earth: Missing Earth. You're a little all over the place. Plans change, meals get skipped, home is wherever you last dropped your bag. You're adaptable, sure, but you never quite feel settled. Yeon's prescription: routine. Boring, beautiful routine. Same bedtime, real meals, one corner of your home that's only yours. Grounded people make better decisions. Yes, I'm looking directly at you.
balance_text.too_much_metal: Too much Metal. You're sharp, critical, and your opinions come with edges. You decide fast and judge faster. People respect you, and also slightly fear your face in meetings. Yeon's prescription: soften up. Ask before you judge. Let some things stay imperfect. Cry at a film. You can keep your standards and still let people near you without running a full security check first.
balance_text.missing_metal: Missing Metal. Boundaries? Never heard of them. You say yes when you mean no, answer messages at midnight, and lend people your time without ever getting it back. Yeon's prescription: one no a week, with no explanation attached. Declutter something. Unsubscribe, unfollow, unclench. A boundary isn't mean. It's just a door with a lock, and you're allowed to own the key.
balance_text.too_much_water: Too much Water. You think. And think. And then think about what you thought. You feel everything and analyse it until it turns to soup. Your intuition is brilliant. Your sleep schedule is not. Yeon's prescription: get out of your head and into your body. Walk, cook, lift something heavy. Put a timer on the overthinking. Then go and live a little.
balance_text.missing_water: Missing Water. You go, go, go and never stop to feel anything. Rest is for the weak, reflection is a waste of time, and you've been busy for about five years straight. Yeon's prescription: sit still. Ten minutes. No phone. Write one honest line before bed. Your feelings don't disappear because you're running. They just wait for you, patiently, like a bill.

too_much_wood.speaker: yeon
too_much_wood.text: Too much Wood. You started a new life plan on Monday. It's Wednesday. New plan.

too_much_wood.speaker: bom
too_much_wood.text: All that drive is wonderful. Finishing one thing will feel even better.

too_much_fire.speaker: yeon
too_much_fire.text: Too much Fire: three dramatic exits from group chats this year. I counted.

too_much_fire.speaker: bom
too_much_fire.text: Your passion lights rooms up. Count to ten before the big reply.

too_much_earth.speaker: yeon
too_much_earth.text: Heavy Earth: same order, same route, same hoodie since 2019. I see you.

too_much_earth.speaker: bom
too_much_earth.text: Your steadiness makes people feel safe. Try one new thing for fun.

too_much_metal.speaker: yeon
too_much_metal.text: Lots of Metal. Your honesty has made two baristas reconsider their careers.

too_much_metal.speaker: bom
too_much_metal.text: Your clarity is a gift. Wrap it in a little kindness.

too_much_water.speaker: yeon
too_much_water.text: Overflowing Water: you've overthought this reading three times already. Stop.

too_much_water.speaker: bom
too_much_water.text: Your depth is beautiful. Come back to shore when it gets heavy.

missing_wood.speaker: yeon
missing_wood.text: No Wood, no ambition. Your five-year plan is 'see what happens'.

missing_wood.speaker: bom
missing_wood.text: Missing Wood just means growth needs a nudge. One small goal is plenty.

missing_fire.speaker: yeon
missing_fire.text: No Fire. You'd describe your best night out ever as 'fine'. Show some spark!

missing_fire.speaker: bom
missing_fire.text: Missing Fire can mute your joy. Do one thing just because it's fun.

missing_earth.speaker: yeon
missing_earth.text: No Earth. You've changed flat, job and hair colour twice this year.

missing_earth.speaker: bom
missing_earth.text: Missing Earth makes it hard to settle. A simple routine is grounding.

missing_metal.speaker: yeon
missing_metal.text: No Metal. You've never said no to anyone in your life, have you?

missing_metal.speaker: bom
missing_metal.text: Missing Metal means boundaries take practice. Start with one tiny no.

missing_water.speaker: yeon
missing_water.text: No Water. Someone cried in front of you and you offered a snack.

missing_water.speaker: bom
missing_water.text: Missing Water can hide feelings. Name one out loud today.
